## NomiFun v0.7.0

- Creative Studio 全面升级为 Canvas-first，新增画布、导演、提示词、素材、模板及图像/视频/音频工作台。 / Creative Studio is now Canvas-first, with new canvas, director, prompt, asset, template, and image/video/audio workbenches.
- Agent 能力支持持久化会话、画布操作、提案确认、任务历史与恢复保护。 / Agent workflows now support durable sessions, canvas operations, proposal confirmation, task history, and recovery safeguards.
- 模型与供应商配置更清晰，支持自动兼容配置、显示名称和编辑时查看已保存 API Key。 / Model and provider configuration is clearer, with automatic compatibility setup, display names, and saved API key visibility while editing.
- 浏览器使用更稳定，优化内存归因、超限回收和智能显示策略。 / Browser use is more reliable with improved memory attribution, reclaim behavior, and smart visibility.
- 完善中英文界面与系统语言跟随，提升多语言使用体验。 / English and Chinese localization is more complete, with system-language detection for a smoother multilingual experience.
- 优化画布加载、资源查询和视口交互，减少等待并提升操作流畅度。 / Canvas loading, asset queries, and viewport interactions are faster and smoother.
- 改进 Windows 安装与数据目录分离，并完善 updater 发布支持。 / Windows installation and data-root separation are improved, with stronger updater release support.
